subject.title: build: refresh Worker and Actions tooling

question: Should this PR keep the flagged @typescript/native-preview and oxfmt updates, or should those bumps be deferred until the Socket warnings are resolved?
rationale: Socket reports high-warning publisher-change and obfuscated-code alerts on dependencies this PR introduces, and automation cannot decide the repository's acceptable supply-chain risk.

options.title: Resolve flagged bumps first
options.body: Defer or replace the flagged @typescript/native-preview and oxfmt updates while keeping the rest of the compatible tooling refresh where possible.

options.title: Accept the supply-chain risk
options.body: A maintainer records an acceptable-risk decision after reviewing the package source/provenance, then the PR can proceed with proof and green checks.

options.title: Pause the refresh
options.body: Hold or close the tooling refresh until upstream package ownership/obfuscation alerts are cleared or a narrower update is available.

recommendation.title: Resolve flagged bumps first
recommendation.body: Defer or replace the flagged @typescript/native-preview and oxfmt updates while keeping the rest of the compatible tooling refresh where possible.

likelyOwner.reason: The same handle has the strongest recent history on Worker dependency refreshes and CI action pinning in this repository.
